text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited between 8:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Rosemeade Avenue, between Tenby Street and Delroy Drive.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Rosemeade Avenue, between Tenby Street and Delroy Drive.
